Americas.Brand management: Build and protect consumer brand equity for ZeroWater, PurePlay, and Hydroviv across retail shelf, Amazon marketplace, and owned digital channels; manage packaging and NSF claims communication.
Americas.Customer acquisition: Generate new subscriber leads through direct sales teams, inbound digital channels, and local marketing; convert prospects to rental and service contracts with average deal tenure of 3–5 years.
Americas.Account management: Manage the ongoing relationship with contracted B2B and residential accounts; conduct annual reviews, upsell higher-spec equipment, and resolve service escalations before churn.
Americas.Contract & pricing management: Design, administer, and renew rental, service, and supply contracts; manage rate cards, volume discounts, and CPI-linked annual uplifts across the subscriber base.
Americas.Customer retention: Monitor churn signals across the contract book; deploy targeted win-back programs, proactive outreach at renewal windows, and loyalty incentives to protect recurring revenue.
Americas.Retail channel management: Manage retailer relationships, promotional calendars, and ranging decisions with Walmart, Target, Costco, and Amazon 1P/3P; execute joint business plans and negotiate promotional investment.
Americas.Direct-to-consumer sales: Acquire customers directly through brand e-commerce sites, Amazon Stores, and social commerce; optimize conversion funnels, bundle offers, and first-order incentives.
Americas.Subscription management: Manage filter replacement subscription programs; automate replenishment dispatch, minimize skip and cancel rates, and optimize subscriber lifetime value through add-on recommendations.
Americas.Customer loyalty & retention: Engage existing customers through email, loyalty points, and product review programs; use TDS meter data and usage signals to prompt timely filter replacement and brand advocacy.

APAC.Brand management: Sustain the premium positioning of ZIP and Harvey as design-led water brands; manage partnerships with retail premium channels (Harvey Norman, John Lewis) and trade specifiers.
APAC.Retail channel management: Develop and execute retail ranging, planograms, and promotional programs across national electrical and kitchen retail chains; manage sell-through, margin, and returns.
APAC.Direct-to-consumer sales: Drive online unit sales and filter subscriptions through brand websites and digital marketing; manage post-sale onboarding, warranty registration, and the digital customer lifecycle.
APAC.Subscription management: Operate the ongoing filter replacement subscription model; manage automatic dispatch schedules, subscriber communications, pause and cancel flows, and consumable replenishment pricing.
APAC.Customer loyalty & retention: Drive repeat purchase and accessory attachment through loyalty programs, owner communities, and proactive outreach at filter subscription renewal; measure NPS and act on detractor feedback.

corporate.Market intelligence: Aggregate competitive landscape data, consumer trend research, and peer benchmarks (Pentair, Veralto, A.O. Smith, Zurn Elkay, Primo Brands) to inform group strategy; commission primary research on water quality awareness.

corporate.Pricing strategy: Set group pricing philosophy and guardrails for rental rates, subscription pricing, and OEM supply; provide analytical frameworks for price-to-value positioning in each market segment.

Americas.Water treatment innovation: Develop and certify new softener, filtration, and RO system configurations for residential and commercial applications; manage NSF/WQA certifications and EU Water Framework Directive compliance across product ranges.
Americas.Product portfolio management: Define the active product range — softeners, dispensers, RO units, salt-free conditioners — including equipment grading, retirement decisions, and new model introductions across each market.
Americas.Installation & commissioning: Survey, design, and install water treatment systems at residential and commercial premises; certify installation quality to NSF, WRAS, DWI, and ACS plumbing and water-quality standards.
Americas.Planned maintenance: Execute scheduled service visits for salt replenishment, filter cartridge replacement, resin regeneration, and system health checks; optimize visit frequency to minimize cost per service event.
Americas.Break-fix & repair: Diagnose and resolve unplanned equipment failures at customer premises; manage spare parts availability, first-time fix rates, and SLA compliance for residential and commercial customers.

EMEA.Connected device management: Remotely monitor and manage the installed estate of IoT-connected dispensers; use telemetry data on filter saturation, water temperature, and fault codes to trigger predictive maintenance and reduce unnecessary truck rolls.

APAC.Product research & development: Conduct consumer research, engineering design, and prototype testing for next-generation HydroTap and Harvey softener products; manage IP pipeline and WELS, WRAS, and AS/NZS certification programs.
APAC.Product portfolio management: Manage the active range of HydroTap models (G5 residential, commercial, ZipChief) and Harvey softener variants (Minimax, HarveyArc) including pricing tiers, accessories, and end-of-life decisions.
APAC.Manufacturing: Operate ZIP's Sydney assembly facility and Harvey's Woking softener and block-salt manufacturing plant; manage production scheduling, component sourcing, assembly quality control, and CAPEX planning.
APAC.Installation & commissioning: Coordinate plumber and trade-channel installation of HydroTap and Harvey units; provide technical training to the approved installer network and manage warranty registration at point of installation.
APAC.Subscription fulfilment: Pick, pack, and dispatch filter cartridge and salt block subscription orders to consumer homes on schedule; manage shipment tracking, non-delivery resolution, and returns handling for recurring subscribers.

corporate.R&D governance: Coordinate intellectual property strategy across ZIP, Harvey, Paragon, and Culligan's filter innovation programs; manage cross-BU technology sharing agreements and group R&D investment prioritization.

Americas.Route planning & optimization: Design and continuously optimize service route sequences to maximize daily service calls per technician; use geographic density modelling to reduce drive time and fuel cost across the fleet.
